scoring_methodology: Weighted deduction framework based on OWASP Top 10, real execution tracing, static code analysis, and database schema review. Critical vulnerabilities (-15 to -20 pts), High risks (-8 to -12 pts), Medium bottlenecks (-4 to -7 pts). Missing/unverified capabilities penalized appropriately.

security_quality.assessment: Critical authorization flaws (IDOR) on referral update routes and session persistence for deactivated accounts.
weaknesses: IDOR in DocumentController::updateReferral and updateSectionReferral allowing cross-section document tampering
Deactivated employee accounts retain active sessions until session cookie expiration
Missing password change session invalidation (logout other devices)
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE defaults to null if not explicitly set in .env
security_quality.recommended_improvements: Implement DocumentPolicy authorization on referral edits, create ActiveEmployeeMiddleware, enforce SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true

application_performance.assessment: Compounding network latency to Tokyo PostgreSQL server exacerbated by silent N+1 query cascades in model accessors.
weaknesses: Document model $appends dynamically queries tracking history relations per row
Correlated overdue() subquery aggregates entire tracking_histories table per request
Supabase Tokyo round-trip latency (~600ms) without persistent connection pooling
application_performance.supporting_evidence: app/Models/Document.php lines 25, 200-245, 254; config/database.php pgsql driver configuration
application_performance.recommended_improvements: Remove eager calculations from $appends, use Inertia resources, configure connection pooling / PgBouncer

database_efficiency.assessment: Solid relational schema and foreign keys, but lacks composite indexes on heavily filtered columns and visibility scans cause full sequential scans.
weaknesses: DocumentService::applyVisibility executes 6 chained OR/orWhereHas branches causing Postgres Seq Scans
Missing composite index on documents(section_id, status_id) and tracking_histories(document_id, tracked_at DESC)
Missing index on audit_logs(auditable_type, auditable_id)
database_efficiency.recommended_improvements: Add composite indexes migration, refactor visibility filter into UNION or indexed view

concurrent_user_handling.assessment: High probability of race condition failures and duplicate tracking number generation under concurrent submission bursts.
weaknesses: generateTrackingNumber relies on Document::max('document_id') + 1 which allows phantom reads during concurrent transactions
Row locking during receive/forward can lead to lock wait timeouts under burst load
PostgreSQL connection limit on remote instance vulnerable to exhaustion with >50 concurrent clients
concurrent_user_handling.recommended_improvements: Implement PostgreSQL SEQUENCE for tracking numbers, introduce atomic DB locks or counter table, configure queue workers

backend_architecture.assessment: Well-structured service classes (DocumentService) and comprehensive audit logging, but bloated controllers handling multiple unrelated domains.
weaknesses: DocumentController violates SRP by managing registration, referrals, remarks, and transmittals
State mutation logic embedded directly within model accessors
Duplicate search endpoints across web.php
backend_architecture.recommended_improvements: Split DocumentController into domain controllers, keep model accessors pure

frontend_code_quality.assessment: Clean React component modularity and Tailwind UI design, but missing useMemo on heavy filtering and lacking DOM virtualization for large tables.
weaknesses: Unmemoized document filtering in Dashboard.jsx and Documents.jsx triggers re-calculation on every keystroke
Large document tables render thousands of DOM nodes without virtual scrolling
Potential memory leaks in modal keydown event listeners
frontend_code_quality.recommended_improvements: Wrap filter functions in useMemo, implement @tanstack/react-virtual on document tables

api_reliability.assessment: Inertia endpoints provide smooth validation error handling, but lacks uniform API error contract and rate-limiting outside standard throttle.
weaknesses: Registration desk and referral endpoints lack granular rate limiting
No automated retry or graceful degradation when remote database times out
api_reliability.recommended_improvements: Add dedicated throttle middleware (e.g. throttle:referrals, throttle:uploads)

error_handling.assessment: Database transactions properly roll back on failure in DocumentTrackingController, but uncaught remote database connection failures trigger raw 500 pages.
weaknesses: Uncaught PDO exceptions when Supabase connection drops expose framework stack trace if APP_DEBUG=true
Frontend lacks React ErrorBoundary components around dynamic modals
error_handling.recommended_improvements: Add React ErrorBoundaries, customize exception rendering for connection timeouts

scalability.assessment: Architecture currently constrained by single-node assumptions: file-based sessions, synchronous PDF rendering, unindexed OR queries.
weaknesses: SESSION_DRIVER=file prevents multi-server load balancing
Synchronous transmittal generation during request cycle blocks web workers
Postgres queries will degrade exponentially as tracking_histories table exceeds 100k rows
scalability.recommended_improvements: Switch session driver to redis or database, queue PDF generation jobs

production_readiness.assessment: The system lacks production security headers, robust session invalidation, concurrency locks, and database connection pooling.
weaknesses: No Content Security Policy (CSP) headers
Insecure cookie defaults if env variables are omitted
Database sequence race conditions not resolved
production_readiness.recommended_improvements: Add security headers middleware, configure Redis for cache/sessions, resolve concurrency bugs
